metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Formal Trust Model
metadata.description: Formal trust model organized by roles (owner/deployer/caller/operator/output) defining trust levels for each component and identifying trust boundary edges.

role_definitions.description: Entity with privileged operations on contracts (upgrade, setMinter, registerToken, etc.)
Entity performing initial contract deployment and configuration
Entity invoking contract public functions (users, other contracts, external services)
Entity managing off-chain service operations (server management, configuration changes)
Data produced by off-chain services that flows to on-chain components

trust_levels.description: Fully trusted. Compromise is out of scope for audit. Assumed to behave correctly.
Under audit. Implementation correctness must be verified. Inter-contract calls fall here.
Partially trusted. Requires validation/verification but not assumed malicious. External dependencies.
Not trusted. Assumed potentially malicious. All inputs must be validated.

on_chain_components.name: Verifier Contract
on_chain_components.description: Manages Nova/Groth16 proof validation and cross-chain coordination with cryptographic guarantees.

roles.rationale: Verifier deploy/update requires owner privileges. Owner compromise is out of audit scope.
Has equivalent privileges to Owner for initial setup.
Users submit proofs but are verified via ZKP soundness.
Receives cross-chain messages. Peer verification required via EID validation.

on_chain_components.name: zERC20 Token Contract
on_chain_components.description: Core token contract implementing ERC20 with value constraints and hash chain integrity.

roles.rationale: setMinter, upgrade privileges. Owner compromise is out of audit scope.
Performs initial configuration.
Calls transfer, approve, etc. Malicious inputs expected.
Calls mint/burn. Implementation correctness is under audit.

on_chain_components.name: LiquidityManager Contract
on_chain_components.description: Sole authority for minting/burning zERC20 with incentive curve enforcement.

roles.rationale: Fee params configuration. Misconfiguration is Informational severity.
Underlying token setup. Fee-on-Transfer token configuration is operational responsibility.
Calls wrap/unwrap. Malicious inputs expected.

on_chain_components.name: Hub Contract
on_chain_components.description: Central aggregation point with PoseidonT3 tree computation and LayerZero message handling.

roles.rationale: registerToken, _delegate configuration privileges.
Performs initial configuration.
Receives via _lzReceive. Peer verification required. _delegate should be documented as owner-operated.
May call broadcast. Inputs must be validated.

on_chain_components.name: Adaptor Contract
on_chain_components.description: Handles cross-chain exit coordination with slippage protection.

roles.rationale: Configuration change privileges.
Performs initial configuration.
Sends bridge requests. Slippage and other params must be validated.

lzCompose callbacks from Stargate bridge. Called when cross-chain token transfer completes on destination chain. Stargate invokes lzCompose with OFTReceipt containing amountReceivedLD. Adaptor must validate sender is authorized Stargate endpoint and handle slippage between expected and received amounts.

validation_required: Amount received meets minAmountOut slippage limit

off_chain_components.name: Prover/Decider Service
off_chain_components.description: Converts Nova IVC proofs to Groth16 proofs for on-chain verification.

roles.rationale: Server operation/management. Performance is operator responsibility.
Sends proof generation requests.
Generated proofs may be invalid. Contract-side soundness verification required. Proof serialization/malleability is non-issue if ZKP has soundness.

security_notes: ZKP soundness ensures that prover-submitted proof serialization or malleability is not a security concern.
Availability/performance issues are operator responsibility, not security vulnerabilities.

off_chain_components.name: Indexer Service
off_chain_components.description: Provides Merkle proofs from indexed on-chain events.

roles.rationale: Server operation/management. Availability is operator responsibility.
Sends Merkle proof retrieval requests.
Provided data is used as ZK circuit inputs but ultimately verified on-chain.

off_chain_components.name: Cross-Chain Job (Broadcast Trigger)
off_chain_components.description: Off-chain service that monitors verifier states and triggers broadcasts.

roles.rationale: Checks each verifier's state and triggers broadcast.

security_notes: isUpToDate should NOT be referenced on-chain; operator should check state off-chain.
Recommendation: Remove isUpToDate from on-chain interface.

off_chain_components.name: IC Key Manager Canister
off_chain_components.description: Internet Computer canister managing stealth address secrets.

roles.rationale: Internet Computer infrastructure operation.
Sends secret key retrieval requests.

off_chain_components.name: IC Storage Canister
off_chain_components.description: Internet Computer canister providing encrypted state storage.

roles.rationale: Internet Computer infrastructure operation.
Sends state storage requests.

external_dependencies.name: LayerZero v2 Network
external_dependencies.description: External cross-chain messaging infrastructure with 13/19 guardian supermajority.
external_dependencies.rationale: Message delivery infrastructure. Peer verification required on receiving contracts.
external_dependencies.validation_requirement: Source EID must be validated against registered peer list.

external_dependencies.name: Stargate Bridge
external_dependencies.rationale: lzCompose callbacks. Slippage protection mitigates risks.
external_dependencies.validation_requirement: minAmountOut slippage limits must be enforced.

cryptographic_primitives.name: Poseidon Hash Circuit
cryptographic_primitives.rationale: Audited light-poseidon library with circom-compatible configurations. Mathematical soundness.

cryptographic_primitives.name: Baby JubJub Curve Operations
cryptographic_primitives.rationale: zkSNARK-friendly elliptic curve on BN254 embedded curve. Mathematical soundness.

cryptographic_primitives.name: Nova Folding Circuit
cryptographic_primitives.rationale: sonobe/folding-schemes library for IVC. Mathematical soundness.

by_role.description: Privilege compromise is out of audit scope. Multisig/governance operation assumed.
Initial configuration responsibility. Misconfiguration is Informational severity.
Malicious inputs expected. Self-inflicted attacks are not vulnerabilities.
LayerZero, Stargate, etc. Peer/sender verification required.
Inter-contract calls. Implementation correctness under audit.
Service operation responsibility. Availability/performance is operator's responsibility.
Generated proofs may be invalid. Soundness verification on-chain.

out_of_scope.description: Vulnerabilities that require manipulating deployment-time parameters or require contract-owner privileges to exploit.
Attacks related to the circuits' trusted setup. Current implementation uses a fixed seed for development/testing, but production assumes a proper trusted setup.
DoS achieved solely by issuing a large number of transfers.
Bugs that affect only the attacker themselves.

Submitting intentionally failing cross-chain messages due to insufficient gas to force honest cross-chain job executors to retry. Not considered an attack if the retry cost for the honest executor is lower than the cost of executing the job directly.

out_of_scope_exceptions.description: Cross-chain messaging attacks that make the retry cost exceed the cost of direct execution.
Cross-chain messaging attacks that create a non-retryable or irrecoverable state.

informational_items: _delegate operation - should be documented as owner-operated
isUpToDate removal recommendation - should be off-chain only

severity_definitions.description: Lack of ZKP soundness; can lead to asset theft, permanent asset lock, or systemic failure.
examples: ZKP circuit soundness vulnerability allowing forged proofs
Double-spend via totalTeleported bypass
Unauthorized minting leading to infinite token inflation
Permanent fund lock with no recovery path

severity_definitions.description: Confidentiality breaches; low-cost, easy-to-execute attacks that can halt the system (i.e., potential damage greatly exceeds attack cost); temporary asset lock.
examples: Privacy leak exposing user transaction linkability
DoS attack halting cross-chain messaging at low cost
Temporary fund lock requiring admin intervention
Griefing attacks with asymmetric cost/damage ratio

severity_definitions.description: Exploitable only under specific preconditions or limited scenarios; examples include an effective security level at or below 90 bits.
examples: Attack requiring specific contract state or timing
Cryptographic weakness with 90-bit or lower security
Front-running vulnerability in specific transaction sequences
Partial information disclosure under constrained conditions

severity_definitions.description: Little direct impact on safety but may induce operational misuse, seed future compound failures, or degrade availability/cost.
examples: Gas inefficiency enabling economic griefing
Missing event emissions hindering off-chain monitoring
Suboptimal error handling masking root causes
Minor availability degradation under edge cases

severity_definitions.description: Departures from ZKP/contract best practices or minor design shortcomings; risk is indirect.
examples: Code style inconsistencies
Missing NatSpec documentation
Redundant storage reads (non-critical gas waste)
Recommended but non-essential safety checks
Design suggestions for future extensibility

boundary_edges.description: Untrusted user submits wrap request with amount to LiquidityManager.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Validate amount bounds, verify user balance, ensure value constraint (<=2^248-1).

boundary_edges.description: Untrusted user submits unwrap request to LiquidityManager.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Validate amount, verify zERC20 balance, check liquidity, apply fees correctly.

boundary_edges.description: Untrusted user initiates zERC20 transfer.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Validate BN254 field constraint (<=2^248-1), verify balance, update hash chain correctly.

boundary_edges.description: Untrusted user submits teleport request with Groth16 proof to Verifier.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: CRITICAL: Fully validate Groth16 proof, verify transfer root exists, validate recipient binding, enforce monotonic totalTeleported.

boundary_edges.description: Untrusted user initiates cross-chain bridge via Adaptor.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Validate balance, destination chain, slippage limits, refund address.

boundary_edges.description: Prover service outputs Groth16 proof to user for on-chain submission.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Proof will be verified on-chain by Verifier. Soundness provides security.

boundary_edges.description: Indexer provides Merkle proofs to user for ZK circuit inputs.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Proofs verified cryptographically during circuit execution and on-chain.

boundary_edges.description: LayerZero delivers cross-chain message to Hub.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: CRITICAL: Validate source EID against registered Verifier list before accepting payload.

boundary_edges.description: LayerZero delivers global root from Hub to Verifier.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: CRITICAL: Validate source EID is authorized Hub before storing global root.

boundary_edges.description: Verifier sends proved transfer root via LayerZero.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Outbound message integrity depends on LayerZero guardian supermajority.

boundary_edges.description: Hub broadcasts aggregation root via LayerZero.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Receiving Verifiers must validate source EID is authorized Hub.

boundary_edges.description: Adaptor sends underlying tokens via Stargate bridge.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Enforce minAmountOut slippage limits. Stargate security is external dependency.

boundary_edges.description: Stargate bridge invokes lzCompose callback on Adaptor after cross-chain token transfer completes.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: CRITICAL: Validate sender is authorized Stargate endpoint. Verify amountReceivedLD meets minAmountOut slippage limit. Handle refund logic if slippage exceeded. Prevent reentrancy via lzCompose callback.
security_notes: lzCompose is called by Stargate after token transfer - Adaptor does not control when this is invoked
Slippage between amountSentLD and amountReceivedLD is expected due to bridge fees
Refund address in composeMsg must be validated to prevent fund misdirection
Reentrancy risk: lzCompose callback occurs before Adaptor's original transaction completes

boundary_edges.description: LiquidityManager calls mint/burn on zERC20.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: zERC20 must verify caller is authorized minter. Amount calculation correctness under audit.

boundary_edges.description: Owner triggers contract upgrade via UUPS proxy.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Owner compromise out of scope. Compensating controls: multisig, monitoring, upgrade alerts.
boundary_edges.security_note: No timelock protection. Malicious upgrades take immediate effect.

boundary_edges.description: Owner grants/revokes minting authority on zERC20.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Owner compromise out of scope. Compensating controls: multisig, minter monitoring.
boundary_edges.security_note: No timelock. Compromised owner can grant unlimited minting to attacker.

boundary_edges.description: Owner registers new token mapping on Hub.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Owner compromise out of scope. Compensating controls: multisig, registration monitoring.

boundary_edges.description: Owner configures verifier parameters.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Owner compromise out of scope. Malicious keys could accept forged proofs.

boundary_edges.description: Owner configures fee parameters on LiquidityManager.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: Owner misconfiguration is Informational. Extreme fees (0% or 100%) possible.
boundary_edges.security_note: No timelock. Compensating controls: multisig, fee bounds checks recommended.

boundary_edges.description: Verifier calls teleport on zERC20 to mint tokens after successful ZKP validation.
boundary_edges.validation_requirement: CRITICAL: zERC20.teleport() must verify msg.sender == verifier(). This is a privileged minting pathway separate from LiquidityManager. A bug in Verifier's proof validation could lead to unauthorized minting.
security_notes: This is the second privileged minting pathway (first is LiquidityManager.mint())
Verifier.teleport() → zERC20.teleport() is a synchronous call, not a callback
zERC20.totalTeleported is incremented here, not in LiquidityManager flows
Proof validation bugs in Verifier directly enable unauthorized minting via this edge

critical_boundaries_summary.description: All user interactions with protocol contracts
critical_boundaries_summary.validation_principle: All user inputs must be cryptographically validated or bounds-checked before state changes

critical_boundaries_summary.description: LayerZero message passing between Hub and Verifier contracts
critical_boundaries_summary.validation_principle: Source endpoint ID (EID) must be validated against registered peer list before accepting any message payload

critical_boundaries_summary.description: Data from off-chain services used on-chain
critical_boundaries_summary.validation_principle: All off-chain data verified cryptographically on-chain (ZK proofs, Merkle proofs)

critical_boundaries_summary.description: Calls between protocol contracts including both minting pathways
critical_boundaries_summary.validation_principle: Caller authorization must be verified (minter() for LiquidityManager, verifier() for teleport). Implementation correctness under audit. Both pathways can mint zERC20 - ensure no double-counting or bypass.
Owner compromise out of scope. No timelock. Compensating controls required (multisig, monitoring).

critical_boundaries_summary.description: Bidirectional cross-chain asset bridging via Stargate
critical_boundaries_summary.validation_principle: Outbound: Slippage limits (minAmountOut) protect against fees/manipulation. Inbound (lzCompose): Validate sender endpoint, verify received amount meets slippage limit, handle refunds correctly. Stargate security is external dependency.
